plan.request: Transform the park into a cinematic Chinese fantasy garden with distant floating mountains, ornate pavilions, and drifting cherry petals. Dress the person in embroidered silk hanfu. Preserve the face, phone, hand movements, and camera motion.

input.prompt: Replace the park background with a cinematic Chinese fantasy garden from the first frame throughout. Behind the man, place large ornate pavilions on both sides of the path: red carved columns, golden brackets, sweeping jade-tiled roofs. Replace the grassy hillside with misty terraces and pale stone balustrades. Above the pavilions, clearly visible through gaps in the cherry canopy, suspend distant rocky mountains in the sky, their pointed undersides hanging above open air and clouds. Keep flowering cherry trees framing the garden. Scatter gently drifting cherry petals through foreground and background. Dress the man in midnight-blue silk hanfu with gold floral embroidery, an ivory crossed collar and flowing sleeves ending behind his visible hands. Preserve his face, hair, sunglasses and expressions. Preserve the original single phone: initially concealed, then retrieved and raised with exactly the source hand movements and timing. Keep the original camera movement and framing progression. Photorealistic fantasy cinema, soft sunlight and atmospheric depth.
